mcqs.label: Review Ex 9 Q1(ix)
mcqs.stem: In a regular hexagon, the ratio of the length of a diagonal to the side length is:
rationales: √3 : 1 is the shorter diagonal; the book means the longest diagonal.
The longest diagonal of a regular hexagon passes through the centre and equals two sides, so the ratio is 2 : 1.
2 : 3 is upside down and does not match any diagonal.
